modalities.evidence: This dataset contains the EEG recordings
behavioral improvements in a covert attention task

output.population: Fourteen healthy subjects (seven female, seven male), age 23±1.52 years, with normal or corrected to normal vision
output.summary: EEG recordings from healthy adults performing a covert visual attention task with real-time feedback on alpha power lateralization, including offline, catch, sham and real online conditions, from a published study.
